coefficient_convention: All kH coefficients, mean/SEM/SD are raw code values; no sign or full-bias conversion was applied
eventual_plot_conversion: Convert mean/dephasing kH to paper kappa=-raw/4 once; SEM/SD to raw/4
scan_scope: Only EF=.5 at T=0 disorder and elastic spin probes; original EF=.3/.4 production data not changed
electrostatics: Thermal injectivities averaged before local-neutrality ratio; U^(1) only; no full Poisson
disorder_model: iid scalar onsite in [-W/2,W/2] times I4; clean electrodes; Mx generally broken
dephasing_model: Paired spin-resolved WBA elastic reservoirs; separate Ip_up(E)=Ip_down(E)=0; no spin relaxation
gamma_phi_interpretation: energy linewidth of phenomenological probe coupling, not calibrated hbar/tau_phi
disordered_gap_scope: The .8 gap statement applies only to the clean bulk Hamiltonian. No global gap is asserted for the disordered scattering region.
disorder_SEM: sample standard deviation ddof=1 divided by sqrt(n); zero for the one clean point

release_portability.note: File paths relocated for the public package. Numeric datasets and historical numerical/source hashes are unchanged. historical_sources entries document unavailable prior generators, not runtime dependencies.
